item.title: Paris Prosecutors Raid X Offices As Part Of Investigation Into Child Abuse Images And Deepfakes
item.description: By SYLVIE CORBET Associated Press PARIS (AP) — French prosecutors raided the offices of Elon Musk’s social media platform X on Tuesday as part of a preliminary investigation into a range of alleged offences, including spreading child sexual abuse images and deepfakes. item.title: ICE Holding Centers
item.description: ICE is looking to expand their space in GOP-led states, which back the President’s immigration plan. Homeland Security is reportedly buying a warehouse near downtown San Antonio, which would be used as a migrant detention center. City Councilman Jalen McKee-Rodriguez says they have little authority to intervene because federal facilities are not required to go through local zoning or permitting processes.

item.title: Sharia Law Pushback
item.description: Lieutenant Governor Dan Patrick has given a list of interim charges to State Senators. Tops on his list is a push to prevent the enforcement of Sharia law in Texas. Sherry Sylvester with the Texas Public Policy Foundation says it’s important the state legislature make it clear that only state and federal law govern Texans.

item.title: Woke Classes Canceled
item.description: Texas A&M has officially canceled a number of Women’s and Gender Studies programs. It’s part of an ongoing purge, led by republicans, who oppose what they call race and gender ideology. And it’s something that Conservative Aggies are happy about. Alumni, like RNC Committeeman Robin Armstrong, say that the fact that only a handful of students showed up to protest the move is proof that students are not interested in “woke” classes.

item.title: ICE Car Crash
item.description: Immigrations and Customs Enforcement agents called on Austin Police Monday after ICE crashed into a resident’s front yard. Viral video shows five Austin Police officers along several unidentified persons who wore face masks and vests reading POLICE gathered near North Lamar Blvd and North Loop. The officers did not assist ICE in any way and cleared the scene. It’s unknown whose car crashed into the yard.

item.title: Trump Signs Bill To End Partial Government Shutdown, Setting Stage For Next Fight
item.description: By KEVIN FREKING Associated Press WASHINGTON (AP) — President Donald Trump signed a roughly $1.2 trillion government funding bill Tuesday that ends the partial federal shutdown that began over the weekend and sets the stage for an intense debate in Congress over Homeland Security funding. item.title: Immigration Agents Draw Guns, Arrest Activists Following Them In Minneapolis
item.description: MINNEAPOLIS (AP) — Immigration officers with guns drawn arrested activists who were trailing their vehicles on Tuesday in Minneapolis, while education leaders described anxiety and fear in Minnesota schools from the ongoing federal sweeps.
